narrative: Day 1 is a clear, cold office day, with all HELIOS work in Tashkent and no presence on the Qizilqum site yet. The day before the Kick-off Meeting is spent setting up project governance: Helios EPC issues its Project Charter and Organisation Chart, and the Contracts Manager formally submits the Advance Payment Guarantee and Performance Security drafts to QSE. On the Client side, QSE confirms the kick-off arrangements and replies to the first contractual letter from Helios.

tasks: Issue the Project Charter for HEL001 covering objectives, scope summary, key milestones M00-M14, governance, authority limits and reporting lines, so it can be presented at the Kick-off Meeting on 2026-12-03
Issue the Project Organisation Chart and Responsibility Matrix (RACI) for the HEP core team, with interfaces to QSE, OWE, UzGridCo and the authorities
Close action ACTIONS-000-004 by confirming the Client attendees, Client Representative and OE contact for the KOM with Khalid Al-Mansoori
Review and approve the Document Control and Numbering Procedure rev A (request REQ-000-epc-docu) or return comments to Nilufar Yusupova

must_produce.title: Project Organisation Chart and Responsibility Matrix
Approval of Document Control and Numbering Procedure rev A and KOM readiness
must_produce.notes: Approve the procedure (or approve it with minor comments) so it can be transmitted to QSE/OWE. Ask the team for final KOM materials by end of day.

tasks: Submit the draft Advance Payment Guarantee (USD 9,500,000, 10% of the Contract Price) and the draft Performance Security in the bank's wording, as required by the Particular Conditions, to QSE for prior approval of form before issue
Ask QSE to confirm the wording and the issuing bank so that the original APG can be issued before the advance payment (A050, M03 2027-01-05)
Progress the NTP precondition checklist for action ACTIONS-000-005 (due 2026-12-03) for presentation at the KOM

must_produce.title: Submission of Advance Payment Guarantee and Performance Security
must_produce.notes: Drafts attached for approval of form. Refer to letter HEL001-L-CO-HEP-QSE-0001. State the amounts, validity and the issuing bank, and request comments within 5 days.

must_produce.title: NTP Precondition Checklist
must_produce.notes: List insurances, APG, Performance Security, permits, land allocation and KOM, each with an owner and a status.

tasks: Reply to HEL001-L-CO-HEP-QSE-0001: confirm that the Employer's executed set of the EPC Contract is complete and initialled, and acknowledge the pre-commencement deliverables list
Note that QSE will review the APG and Performance Security drafts received today and respond on the form of the securities

must_produce.title: Re: Confirmation of Executed Documents and Pre-Commencement Contractual Deliverables
must_produce.notes: Confirm the executed set is complete. Acknowledge the receipt of the APG/PS drafts and say that comments on the form will follow within the review period.

tasks: Reply to the Project Director's letter HEL001-L-PM-HEP-QSE-0001: confirm the KOM on 2026-12-03 at the QSE Tashkent office, the QSE attendees, the Client Representative and the Owner's Engineer (Meridian, Sophie Laurent) attendance
Add QSE agenda items: reporting format, communication protocol and the document review periods

must_produce.title: Re: Confirmation of Contract Signature and Kick-off Meeting Arrangements
must_produce.notes: Confirm the KOM date, time and venue, the attendee list and the Client Representative nomination, and propose additional agenda items.

notes_for_log: Day 1 (2026-12-02): office only, no event-engine happenings. Scripted deliverables were issued: the Project Charter and the Organisation Chart/RACI (PD), and the APG and Performance Security submission letter (CM to QSE CM). QSE replied to both Day 0 letters. A020 KOM preparation is in progress, the KOM is tomorrow. ACTIONS-000-004 is expected to close today and ACTIONS-000-005 is due tomorrow.
